rubric.score_range: Each dimension is scored 0–10. Weighted total = sum(dimension score * weight / 10), out of 100.
rubric.acceptance: Weighted total >=85 AND every dimension meets its floor AND confidence >=0.8 AND all evidence/license gates pass.
rubric.source_requirement: At least two independent external demand/pricing source domains
rubric.interpretation: The same seven-dimension weighted rubric used by the pipeline. Scores are reviewer judgment, not empirical probabilities. No external reviewers, interviews, paid demand, integrated prototypes, measured ROI or profit have been established.
